reasons: Rule is a 'missing' insurance clause and the document genuinely lacks any insurance provision; the proposal inserts a new Section 31 immediately after the final substantive section (Force Majeure), which matches the redline guidance to add a short insurance paragraph in the miscellaneous section.

Inserted language tracks the preferred position exactly: CGL USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M (justified because TrueLink hosts the Web Site and processes Client Content/consumer credit data), statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request, and coverage through the term plus one year.

The conforming change to the Section 24 survival list ('5 through 30' -> '5 through 31') is a one-character, necessary edit so the post-term coverage obligation survives; changed-character ratio of 0.027 confirms minimality.
Comment is accurate, in the required voice and prefix, explains the insertion and the factual basis, cites the playbook amounts, and offers the E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M fallback without lecturing.
